baseline.method: Explicitly corrected independent pymaginverse oracle, degree3, five iterations

threshold_provenance: Current v2: Observation-whitened SSE plus explicitly defined integrated spatiotemporal prior; any equal/better attainable objective accepted. No five-step solver trajectory matching. Numeric objective budgets are predeclared acceptance tolerances, not measured physical uncertainty.
observation_consistency_definition: sqrt(mean(((observed - predicted)/provided_sigma)^2)) per F/I/D type; angular quantities use degrees and declination residual wraps into [-180,180]. Public data only; predicted from submitted spline coefficients using independent potential gradient and geometric ellipsoid conversion.
evaluation_semantics: Observation-whitened SSE plus explicitly defined integrated spatiotemporal prior; any equal/better attainable objective accepted. No five-step solver trajectory matching.
baseline_role: Historical v1 numerical/stage comparison and attainable source observation fit; self-agreement values are not current acceptance criteria.
historical_v1_threshold_provenance: Independent unmodified and minimal physics-corrected oracle captures precede extraction. Corrected oracle vs SciPy-only extracted implementation differs at approximately 1e-15 relative scale. Nonzero 1e-7 dynamic-range tolerance covers numerical backend variation, with each of15 epoch/components and spline coefficients scored separately.
